note: The property-name graph of each pinned CRD's spec, derived by tests/substrate-crd/regen.py from the same release URL templates/substrate/install.sh applies. Object -> {key: model}, array -> {'[]': model}, primitive or additionalProperties map -> True, arbitrary-key map -> '*'. NOT a type check and not exhaustive of Kubernetes semantics: it catches a field NAME the pinned CRD does not declare, which is exactly the class of defect CNPG's strict decoding refuses at apply time.
